scope: Corollary 12.1 (Finite generation for rational lc pairs) of the manuscript “Log abundance in characteristic zero” (preprints/Log-abundance-in-characteristic-zero-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 034 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 87b191f75e8c8526), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 76. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: (i) Let k be an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero, let (X, ∆) be a normal projective log canonical pair over k, and assume that ∆ ≥ 0 is rational and D = KX + ∆ is Q-Cartier. Then R(X, D) = M m≥0 H0 X, OX(⌊mD⌋)  is a finitely generated k-algebra. (ii) Let (X, ∆) be a log canonical pair over C, with ∆ ≥ 0 rational and KX + ∆ Q-Cartier. For every proper morphism f : X → S onto an algebraic variety S, the relative log canonical algebra R(X/S, KX + ∆) = M m≥0 f∗OX ⌊m(KX + ∆)⌋  is a finitely generated OS-algebra.
